messages.author: 5b7b216615fd9b53
messages.subject: Issues with deploying
parts:
I am trying to deploy my app to shinyapps.io for the first time and I have the following messages come up:

1. Warning: unable to access index for repository /src/contrib:
  unsupported URL scheme

2. Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- "digest"

3. In fileDependencies.R(tempfile) :
  No file at path 'C:/.../AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpU1uIzi/file17941dcd7e0e'. 

(This one comes up 45 times with various numbers after 'file')

4. In readLines(file) :
  incomplete final line found on 'C:/..../AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpU1uIzi/file1794345f4db2/knitr/examples/child/knitr-main.Rnw'

5. In FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
  Package 'Formula' not available in repository or locally

(This message comes up for a number of packages)

I have deployed one (much simpler) app once before by adding all required packages to the Shiny code folder (the one with UI and Server code) but I have a feeling that is not working now.

Any ideas on how to fix these? Please explain in simple terms, I am very new to this...

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Issues with deploying
parts:
1. How did you install your R packages? What is the output of rsconnect::appDependencies() and devtools::session_info()?

2. See #1

3. How are you using temp files in your code? shinyapps.io runs on Linux, so all paths within your code should be relative, and nowhere should you see "C:" as that is Windows specific.

4. See #3

5. See #1
